messages:
zoe: dropping a quick prototype for Threshold Preview ordering + suppression visibility. Main questions: keep suppressed channels in the list (greyed) or collapse them into a "hidden" section? Also thinking about the 'Priority' chip wording. Figma: https://figma.redwood/threshold-preview-order (WIP) raj: product POV keep suppressed channels visible but de-emphasized. Hiding causes support tickets where customers think rules disappeared. Make the reason obvious (short line + tooltip). mina: a11y notes do not rely on visual de-emphasis only. Add an sr-only reason string and ensure DOM order matches visual order. Example SR text: "Slack (suppressed until 14:00)". Also add an aria-live announcement when suppression toggles:
Channel Suppressed: Slack until 14:00
so screen readers get context. dave: implementation tip we can reuse the collapsed-row pattern from Notify Matrix. For drag-and-drop reorder, use a keyboard fallback (space to pick up, arrows to move). Announce moves like: "Slack moved to position 1" via live region. zoe: copy options for the chip: "Effective priority", "Delivery priority", "Active priority". Which reads better? Also small hint text under chip: "Calculated from routing and suppression" or "Calculated from route order and suppression rules"? mina: prefer "Delivery priority" (shorter). For the hint, shorter is better: "From route order & suppression." raj: +1 for keeping suppressed rows visible. UX tweak: show a tiny expand arrow on suppressed rows to reveal the mute reason inline. Button should be keyboard focusable and labelled "Show suppression reason". dave: edge case: many suppressed channels + many active channels on mobile. Suggest collapsing suppressed rows under a single summary line like "3 suppressed channels" that expands. But still expose an SR-only list when collapsed: SR users should be able to access each channel name. mina: accessibility nit when summarizing collapsed suppressed channels, include accessible disclosure:
  • Slack suppressed until 14:00
  • Email suppressed until 14:00
zoe: good. For visual affordances, we'll add a muted icon + italic reason under each suppressed row. Also add a small "Draft" pill when local edits differ from applied rules (not "Unsaved"). raj: add tests: keyboard reorder, suppression expand/collapse SR behavior, and visual regression for suppressed styling. Also include copy A/B for chip wording in the panel. aria-bot: preview branch created: feat/priority-chip-suppression-ux https://git.redwood/feat/priority-chip-suppression-ux zoe: thanks team I'll update Figma with the Delivery priority chip, suppressed-row pattern, and the Draft pill. Will attach a short checklist (ARIA strings, reveal button labels, keyboard-dnd) before handoff.
